title: fix(runtime): /ai stops answering a 503 that never clears when the AI route table is never published
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93Eo3KCP47M7MLpfH9wY7Me)_

Fixes #31905

Claim 6740643925 (`domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmQgkihSGa3BRpKum6u). Signal and name ruled by the seat after step 0: the request kernel's boot phase, read through a new `hasBootPhaseSettled('kernel:ready')` on both kernels.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured on head ae41bcd980 against base 489f0cea: an authenticated caller on a booted kernel whose AI service is serveable but publishes no route table got 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` "AI service routes not yet initialized" on every `/ai/*` path on base; on head `GET /ai/agents` answers 200 `{ agents: [] }` and every other `/ai/*` path answers 501 with the remedy sentence, byte-identical to the no-AI-service exit. The 503 was never an accept, so nothing is narrowed. `ObjectKernel` and `LiteKernel` gain one read-only public method, `hasBootPhaseSettled(phase)`, and the exported `DomainHandlerDeps` gains one OPTIONAL member, `isRequestKernelReady?(context)`: an implementation without it still compiles and keeps the 503.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：未授权的企业版镜像会注册 AI 服务但不发布路由表，`/api/v1/ai/*` 以前永远回 503「AI service routes not yet initialized」。现在内核过了 `kernel:ready` 之后路由表仍不存在，就按「没有 AI 服务」回答：`GET /ai/agents` 回 200 空列表（控制台据此隐藏 AI），其余回 501。启动窗口内仍是 503。
- 为什么改：Console 每个页面都请求 `/ai/agents`，未授权安装的每一页都打一条 503 错误，而且 503 告诉客户端「稍后重试」，永远不会好。
- 风险与回滚：只在「内核已就绪 + AI 服务可用 + 无路由表」时改答案。内核没有新方法、`bootPhaseHooks: false`、启动中，一律保持 503，不会把真实的启动竞态答成「AI 关闭」。匿名请求仍先回 401。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts` 的 `if (!routes)` 分支与 `aiUnavailable`；`packages/core/src/kernel.ts` 与 `kernel-base.ts` 的 `hasBootPhaseSettled`；`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 的 `isRequestKernelReady`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts`，预期 24 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/core/src/kernel.ts`, `kernel-base.ts`, `lite-kernel.ts`**: both kernels gain `hasBootPhaseSettled(phase: 'kernel:ready'): boolean`. A private latch is set right after `kernel:ready` has been dispatched and every handler of it has settled. The method answers `true` only for `'kernel:ready'`, only past that point, and only while the kernel is `running`. Every other phase, a kernel still booting, a boot with `bootPhaseHooks: false` (the hook never fires), and a stopped kernel answer `false`. A new reader was needed because both kernels set `state = 'running'` before Phase 2 `start()`, so `isRunning()` / `getState()` cannot tell "plugins still starting" from "booted".
- **`packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.ts`, `http-dispatcher.ts`**: `DomainHandlerDeps` gains an optional `isRequestKernelReady?(context)` (optional because the interface is exported from the runtime root; a deps without it reads as not ready, so the 503 stays). It reads the reader off the request's kernel (`context.kernel ?? defaultKernel`, the same kernel `getRegisteredAiRoutes` reads). A kernel without the reader answers `false`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts`**: the no-AI answer (`GET /ai/agents` → `{ agents: [] }`, everything else → `capabilityUnavailable(deps, 'ai')`) moves, unchanged, into one local `aiUnavailable()`, so both exits that mean "no AI over HTTP" answer from one place. The `!routes` exit keeps the anonymous gate first, then answers `aiUnavailable()` when `deps.isRequestKernelReady?.(context) === true` and keeps the 503 otherwise. The phase is read on every request and never cached, so no verdict is recorded during boot.
- **`.changeset/31905-ai-off-past-kernel-ready.md`**: patch for `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/core`, both declaration lines, and the new kernel method named.

Names (the seat's call, ruled after step 0): `hasBootPhaseSettled` (public, on both kernels) and `isRequestKernelReady` (the internal deps seam). No new error code: the off arm reuses the unserveable exit's 200 and 501.

Forced test edit: `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts`'s `makeDeps` gains the new required seam, defaulting to "not ready". So the existing Group D (the boot-race 503) keeps asserting exactly what it did and is now the CONTROL arm. No existing assertion changed. The same file gains a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'`: Group F drives the real `HttpDispatcher`, whose reach loads that package lazily, and `check:test-source-alias` asks for the load to be paid at collection.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts` (the `handleAIRequest` harness, two new top-level describes):
  - **E (unit, deps double)**: past ready, `GET /ai/agents` and six other paths answer `toEqual` the unserveable exit's result (200 `{ agents: [] }`, 501 + remedy, never 503); a SYSTEM context gets the same; anonymous callers (both shapes) get 401 first and the phase seam is read zero times; CONTROL, before ready the same state keeps 503; CONTROL, a published table is still served past ready; CONTROL, a deps that does not carry the kernel-phase seam keeps the 503 (`/ai/agents` and `/ai/models`).
  - **F (real `ObjectKernel` through `HttpDispatcher.handleAI`)**: reads taken from a plugin's `start()` and from a `kernel:ready` handler get 503, a `kernel:bootstrapped` handler and after boot get 501, `/ai/agents` gets 200 `{ agents: [] }`, and an anonymous caller gets 401. CONTROLs keep 503 for a `bootPhaseHooks: false` boot and a kernel with no reader. A table published in `start()` is still served. The phase is read off the request kernel, not the host kernel, in both directions.
- `packages/core/src/kernel.boot-phase-hooks.test.ts` (top-level describe `ObjectKernel hasBootPhaseSettled`) and `packages/core/src/lite-kernel.test.ts` (`LiteKernel hasBootPhaseSettled`): the answer at init, start, ready, bootstrapped and listening (false, false, false, true, true), after boot, after shutdown (false), for other phase names (false), and under withheld hooks (false throughout).

## Acceptance notes

- **Discovery still advertises the route (carrier: cloud).** On such an install `/api/v1/discovery` reports `services.ai` as `enabled: true, status: 'available', handlerReady: true` (`http-dispatcher.ts` reads `isServiceServeable` on the slot only). The root fix is on the producer: the unlicensed AI service carrying the ADR-0076 D12 marker (`status: 'degraded', handlerReady: false`) would make discovery and this handler's unserveable exit both answer correctly. The seat routes it to the cloud mailbox on landing.
- **The 501 sentence names the package as absent.** The off arm reuses the unserveable exit's sentence exactly ("Provided by @objectstack/service-ai in ObjectOS Cloud/Enterprise — no implementation ships in the open framework"), as the order asks. On an unlicensed Enterprise image the package is present, so the sentence is slightly off for that case. The Console only reads `/ai/agents`, so it never shows it.
- The 503 window is narrow in practice: HTTP listens at `kernel:listening`, after `kernel:ready` has settled. It stays for hosts that dispatch earlier and for kernels that cannot answer.

## Verification

Worktree `objectstack-issue-31905`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' build` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). The suites, base leg and ablations ran on 06a0ff69. The final commit 5b30aebca8 only adds the module-top import to the runtime test file; on it the file re-ran (24 passed), runtime typecheck re-ran (OK), eslint on core and runtime re-ran (exit 0), and the whole dispatch-gates union re-ran.

<details><summary>Package suites, typecheck, lint</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck      → tsc + examples + check:test-typecheck OK
pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck   → tsc + check:test-typecheck OK
pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test           → Test Files 142 passed (142) · Tests 3254 passed (3254)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test        → Test Files 569 passed (569) · Tests 9205 passed | 19 skipped (9224) (on ae41bcd980)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
eslint packages/core packages/runtime --no-inline-config → exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Base leg (the Clause-② measurement on base behaviour)</summary>

The `!routes` exit put back to `main`'s (the phase read removed, so the 503 is unconditional), the new tests run: 6 red, each the base answer. Past ready, `GET /ai/agents` "expected 503 to be 200" (body `{ success: false, error: … }`, not `{ agents: [] }`), `/ai/models` "expected 503 to be 501", the real-kernel `kernel:bootstrapped` read 503. The anonymous pins stay green on base (401 first was already true). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty after each)</summary>

Runtime tests resolve `@objectstack/core` to source through the vitest alias, so no rebuild leg applies.

- A1, `ai.ts`: the phase condition dropped (off arm served whatever the phase). 6 red: D "still tells an authenticated caller…" (expected 501 to be 503), E CONTROL before ready (expected 200 to be 503), F start/ready reads (`{ start: [501] … }`), F withheld hooks, F readerless kernel, F request-kernel direction (each expected 501 to be 503). The first A1 attempt used a replacement contained in the anchor; the tool refused it (count did not rise) and ran nothing. It was re-run with a distinct replacement.
- A2, `ai.ts`: the off arm moved ahead of the anonymous gate. 3 red: E "refuses anonymous callers first" (expected 200 to be 401), E CONTROL (seam read 4 times, not 2), F (anonymous `/ai/agents` expected 200 to be 401). The first A2 attempt kept the anchor inside the replacement; the tool refused it and ran nothing.
- A3, `http-dispatcher.ts`: a kernel without the reader read as ready. 1 red: F "a kernel that carries no phase reader keeps the 503" (expected 501 to be 503).
- A4, `kernel.ts`: the latch set before the ready handlers run. 1 red: `ObjectKernel hasBootPhaseSettled` read-at-each-phase (the `kernel:ready` read became true).
- A5, `lite-kernel.ts`: the same on LiteKernel. 1 red: `LiteKernel hasBootPhaseSettled`.
- A6, `kernel.ts`: the withheld-hooks branch latching. 1 red: "answers false throughout a boot whose boot-phase hooks are withheld" (expected true to be false).
- A7, `ai.ts`: `=== true` swapped for `!== false` on the optional seam. 1 red: E CONTROL "a deps that does not carry the kernel-phase seam keeps the 503" (expected 200 to be 503; 1 failed / 24 passed).
</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

On head 5b30aebca8: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 71 commands; each was run and its exit captured before any pipe; all 71 exit 0. `--ran` with `COMMAND :: exit CODE` lines: "Run reconciliation — 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" and "a DERIVED zero — all 71 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3".

Round 3 (on ae41bcd980, after the seat's should-fix: the deps member made optional): 71 derived, 71 run, a derived zero; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 on a fresh worktree, then 0 after a full `pnpm build`.

Round 1 (on 06a0ff69) was red on `pnpm check:test-source-alias` (exit 1: the test file reached `@objectstack/metadata` lazily through `HttpDispatcher`), fixed by 5b30aebca8. Two more were prerequisite exits there, not verdicts: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 on a shallow clone (deepened with `git fetch --unshallow origin main`, then exit 0) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 on missing dists. Both exit 0 in round 2.
</details>
